snippet.description:
Nothing sets the tone of a movie quite like its opening scene – and that's especially true for Harry Potter. From baby Harry being dropped off at four Privet Drive to the fantastic sights of the Quidditch World Cup to Harry bravely protecting Dudley from a Dementor attack and more, rewatch all eight iconic and memorable openings from the Harry Potter movies!
